segments.text: An orphan who shares a friendly rivalry with Reiji dating back to their time in the same orphanage. He has witnessed incessant war and suffering during travels with his foster father and now bears a deep hatred for "evil".
Ryuuichi is as dense as he is stubborn for justice, reflecting any female affections like a wall.
In battle, his hair becomes blond and his eyes turn green due to him infusing the power of lightning with himself. He is able to move in the speed of light and can deal lightning-based attacks.
Edited from Warum's Review

Ryuuichi is a war orphan who lost his parents during the Fimbulwinter War. Although he lived in the same orphanage as Reiji and even quarrelled with him, he is somehow Reiji's best friend. Because of his serious and awkward personality, Ryuuichi is the polar opposite of Reiji, who is carefree. Since the both of them are rivals, they can only understand each other through their fists.
In battle, Ryuuichi is able to integrate lightning magic into his martial arts techniques. Among the "Mahoutsukai" residing in Tsukiyomi Island, Ryuuichi's ability is one of the top tier ones.
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

Self-proclaimed bishoujo and Reiji's magical weapon. For some reason, she is the only weapon that is allowed outside of Eye Space. Likes animal but animals don’t like her for some reason. Sitting in the sun while dazing off is her daily life.
Clumsy, but a heart warming character that bears the power to destroy an entire planet.
Strangely, Sakura resembles Reiji's dead mother, Yoshino Sakura.

Summoned by Reiji, Sakura is a "Strategic Destruction Magic Weapon" that uses sunlight-fueled attacks. Sakura is a spirit that takes form of a human girl that is good at both attack and defense by converting sunlight into magic. Although she is a spirit, Sakura is able to fight in battles using her human body to use powerful magic attacks. In addition, because she is an autonomous weapon, Sakura is able to fight independently in battles without her user, Reiji. Her last resort mythical magic shines more dazzling than the sun itself, however, its destructive powers is enough to destroy the world. Therefore, she keeps this power hidden.
From Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Summonned by Reiji, Sakura is a "Strategic Destruction Magic Weapon" and a spirit of the Sakura Tree who takes the form of a human girl. She is able to use sunlight-based magic in battles, but is weak when she is in the dark and during nighttime. Sakura's main hobby is basking in the sun. Reiji sometimes jokingly calls her a useless weapon for idling around everyday under the sun on the Sagara household's porch. She tends to dote on Maota, a dog she found who once lost his way back home, and the two of them play together frequently now that he is back with his owners.
As a weapon, Sakura's trump card is her "mythical magic". This hidden mythical magic shines more dazzling than the sun itself and its destructive power is enough to destroy one whole planet.
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

A kendo genius who is a member of the kendo club. She is Ryuuichi’s childhood friend, and has been trying to convey her feelings ever since he came back. Cheerful, open, and friendly, she is straightforward like a sword. Thus Reiji and Momiji like to poke fun at her naïve-niceness. She has a very large appetite, and as well as a large bust, which Momiji teases with.

In battle, Nagisa's hair turns blondish sliver and her eyes turns into amber. Her hair ribbons fall off, letting her long hair down. Nagisa's sword no longer retains its black shell, and is evolved into a new golden sword named Svafrlami.
From Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Although Nagisa may look like a beautiful and intelligent all-around honors student who is good at sports, she is actually a chivalrous girl who is skillful in kendo and terrible at every other sport. Her bright and honest personality has led her to become popular and respected among her peers. She plays the role as the "one being joked on" among her two other friends in the student council.

For Nagisa, her ability to cut her opponents with her sword in one slash will surely kill them. Her battle style is to counterattack her opponents with one swing of her sword, literally "killing them in a single blow".
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

Reiji's younger adopted sister, who comes off as a kuudere. She likes cats, and usually plays with them on her free time. She is very athletic as she is good at every sport in school. Supposingly, she is the same age as Reiji. She doesn’t talk much; but when she does, her messages are direct and to the point.

She has a very large rivalry against Momiji, as the two of them never agree with each other. But when they do, it comes off as a one time situation. The two of them constantly get into fights or arguments the moment they meet each other eye to eye.

After having awakened as a mahoutsukai, Sayuki uses her powers to help various people living in the island in the shadows. She is known as the "Guardian Goddess of Tsukiyomi-jima Island". By helping a lot of people, she has kept them away from troubles involving supernatural powers. Sayuki takes pride in her battle experience when dealing with magic or other mahoutsukais. She is considered a combat expert with her abilities. Using her abilities wisely, Sayuki is able to implement magic into her own body and use it to increase her speed at a godlike level. As long as the target is a living object, a monochrome devil's bullet shot by Sayuki's weapon is said to be unavoidable by any other skill.
From Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Reiji's younger non-blood-related sister, who was reunited with him after four years. Sayuki tends to dote on her older brother to the point were she may have crossed the line as a younger sister. She leads a cat-and-dog life with Momiji, who goes after Reiji at every chance she gets. Although Sayuki does not talk much, her words are usually direct and to the point.

In the past, she used her magic powers to solve and deal with crimes in the shadows in order to protect Tsukiyomi-jima Island, allowing her to gain some battle experience. Sayuki's ability allows her to warp between space and time and move in it. She is able to move at the speed of light skillfully in combat. Because she awoke as a "Mahoutsukai" from an unusual circumstance, her magic weapon that should have been one weapon, split into two identical weapons.
Translated from Getchu

A mischievous, confident, and bold classmate who has hit on Reiji due to "love at first sight". After Reiji transferred into her class, Momiji believed it was fate that brought her closer to him. Since then, she has been continuing to approach him earnestly. When the people closest to her are in harm's way, Momiji's personality takes a complete 180 turn and becomes cold-hearted and cruel like that of the devil himself. A genius and probably could get top grades at school if she tried, though she refuses to confirm it.

Although she has no real battle experience, she has a unique battle sense as she is able to adapt to the situation. With the ability to disrupt her opponent's strategies, Momiji's battle style is very similar to Reiji where she changes her attack styles based on the situation to make up for her lack of battle experience. Her abilities reflect her own character, and her versatility in battle allows her to create various strategies. For her, it can be said that conversations during battle is one of her weapons.
Adapted from Warum's Review & Getchu translation

Momiji's weapon is a system consists of seven crystals hovering behind her, giving the impression of a pair of wings. Each crystal bears the Latin name of a sin in the seven cardinal sins and can shoot out flashes with the same colors. The penetrating beams moves at light speed, making it difficult for a normal human to evade. When the beams hit, Momiji's opponent will be affected by the crystal's special power, which is reducing a sense corresponding to the sin that hit.
From fortissimo Wikia
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

The perfect student council president. She is a genius pianist that likes to read in her free time, and has enough charisma to turn heads. Unfortunately, this also means she is distant from most people as they are afraid of her reverence.
From Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Ayane is the charismatic student council president who is an unrivaled honors student and very versatile in all sports. Even though she is a third-year student, the school has very high hopes in her since she has served as the student council president for three consecutive years. Because Ayane was raised in a family of musicians, she was known as a talented pianist who was able to leave everyone in awe at a young age. Many of her peers respect her for her popularity and beautiful figure, but often keep their distance from her. Ayane is Momiji and Nagisa's best friend, and gives them special treatment using her privilages as the student council president. Because she has very little experience in love, Ayane shows an abnormal love to Reiji and usually stalks him in a bold and frightful, yet fascinating approach.
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

A mysterious girl Ryuuichi met at the Milky Way shopping mall that was done being constructed recently. Although she is a beautiful young girl with fair skin, her attitude is that of a spoiled princess that looks down on others. There are a lot of strange rumors about her due to her tendency to disappear out of nowhere as if a ghost was floating in the air.
Translated from Getchu
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A diminutive girl with fair skin that looks down on strangers with an overbearing attitude. She tends to call Ryuichi her "favorite servant", and he plays along. Kuri spends her everyday life at the dojo where Ryuichi goes to train with Nagisa. Because the both of them are always close to each other, Kuri usually disturbs their love life. She leads a cat-and-dog life with Nagisa, but with Nagisa's gentle nature, the fight turns into a one-sided teasing.

Although Kuri may seem like an ordinary girl, her existence is like that of an "actual ghost". She currently depends on her vessel, a doll, in order to live. Kuri herself is an extremely rare existence with the "ability" to manipulate the dead.
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description
A girl who was Reiji's childhood friend and his former classmate.
Translated from Getchu
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A girl who was Reiji's childhood friend and his former classmate. He was also her first love, and the both of them currently maintain their awkward relationship with each other. Miki's existence is the only "symbol" that Reiji uses to remind him of his normal daily life. She was the first woman to teach him the importance of connecting with others. In the present, Miki is living among her close friends because they were always with her in the past. Moreover, she spends everyday in peace, and tries not to get caught up in any fights. Despite Reiji not telling her about the danger around him, Miki still refers to him as an "ally of justice", or "Miki's ally" to be exact.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: フレイア=シュヴェルトライテ
cast.originalCharacterName: フレイア=シュヴェルトライテ

segments.text: After gaining excellent results, Freya was sent to a SSS-ranked mission as a female "Kisekitsukai". Having been accepted into the "Seventh Chord", she received the title of "The Seventh Seat". Although she was the lowest seat, everyone has high expectations from her. Freya is partnered with Mikoto and Alicia as part of a three-man cell.

During the first war between the mahoutsukai, she had lost her parents and grew up as a war orphan. Ever since then, she bears a deep grudge against all mahoutsukai. Freya has a deep psychology to avoid familial love, since she grew up as a war orphan and mentally depends on herself. Because Julius, her elder brother, had been separated from her all her life, Freya is unsure as to how to approach him.

Freya is skillful in high speed taijutsu and dual-wielding sword combat. Having won many battles without any weapons by constantly training herself, she believed that was her true potential as a tactician who could steadily handle any battles.
Translated from Getchu

The foster father of both Reiji and Freya, Shishou is a one-armed teacher of life lessons. While his true identity is a mystery, it is suspected that he was the former leader of the one of the branches of Voluspa. For the first time in years, he has moved back to Tsukiyomi-jima Island. Because he was in the same organization once, both him and Ichigo are old friends. Because of his kind heart, Shishou provides financial support to the orphanage Reiji once belonged to, "The Saint's Admonition".
Shishou is currently living with Sousei and Sakura at "The Saint's Admonition", and is helping to support the war orphans who lost their parents like Freya.
Although he once helped in the development of the artificial weapon, Kiseki, Shishou actually has a calm and peaceful personality.
Translated from Getchu
Shishou's real name is revealed in the final battle against Loge as Subaru, a former member of Voluspa now in charge of the Subaru Project (a.k.a. Project Svalinn).
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description
The school idol kouhai that has a bit of a clumsy side. She is a miko for the shrine in the island.
She has a childhood friend named Sakurai Shunsuke, whom she usually refers to as "Shun".
Edited from Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A girl who is usually seen wearing a miko uniform. Because she has too much faith as a shrine maiden, Umi alone offers donations as a sign of supremacy. Umi's clumsy side has led her to become very popular from both men and women because they see her as a cute puppy that they have to follow around. She was formerly the school's idol, but her popularity has decreased sharply due to her revealing her aggressive personality. On the contrary, this increases the number of fans who are hiding enthusiastically. In the past, Umi was a shy girl. She had a severe complex for wearing her glasses because she thought people saw her as a weird-looking person. Now, Umi usually uses contacts in public. When she dons her glasses, her character completely changes to a belligerent person.

Because of her coward character, Umi can burn like an enraging fire when push comes to shove. Her two-faced nature allows her to win like a veteran in war with her cold-blooded methods. Umi's sensitivity with a will to slaughter her enemies in the battlefield allows her to produce enormous magical power. It can be said that Umi belongs in the top class of the "Mahoutsukai".
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description
A girl who has lived her life in a hospital due to an incurable disease. Used to be the daughter of a world-renowned billionaire, but now that her parents died she carries the fortune.
Taken from Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Due to her hereditary intractable disease, Hinako had lived in the hospital ever since she was born. She used to be the daughter of a world-renowned billionaire, but she carries the fortune now that her parents died. Her intractable disease has been cured thanks to Reiji, and Hinako has started to attend school, something she had sought for a long time. At school, she gets along well with Umi, as she transferred to the same school and class as her. Because she is always given a ride to and from school by Keisuke, rumors about her being a "young lady" have started to spread around the school.

Because of her lack of battle experience, Hinako's offensive abilities are still in their immature state. However, her defense abilities are at a different level. Her abilities allow her to create a bright magical barrier produced from her innocent heart. No normal attack can penetrate this barrier. Hinako is unexpectedly a belligerent fighter, inventing a fighting style of summoning illusion beasts produced by magic.
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

Ichigo is Reiji and Sayuki's foster mother, and the landlord of the house they are living in. She is a very strange woman as she usually goes to her "job" while wearing a witch costume. She seems to know who Odin is, as she sets out looking for ways to stop Ragnarok.
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A mysterious woman who is the landlord of the Sagara house where Reiji and Sayuki are freeloading in. Ichigo may be an "older" woman due to her age, but she hates being treated like one because of her short stature. Whenever someone casually calls her "Wanko", she gets irrationally angry.

When Ichigo was young, she was an intelligent scientist, who everyone was proud of for having the most brilliant mind in the history of mankind. Her true identity is a mysterious person who earns money through a questionable trade, which she keeps secret from Reiji.
Translated from Getchu
Yoshino Sakura is the wife of Yoshino Sousei and Yoshino Reiji's mother. Her death is the main drive for Sousei to become Odin and hold the ceremony Ragnarök.
From fortissimo Wikia

Reiji's mother. Once a sickly young woman, Sakura is now a healthy and energetic person thanks to Reiji. She is currently living with her husband, Sousei, at "The Saint's Admonition", the orphanage Reiji grew up in, and helping to raise the orphans. Sakura loves to dote on Reiji. She wants to live with him, but he declines her offer, which saddens her. She gets very embarrassed when people say she looks too young to be a mother.
In Kadenz, Sakura has gotten to know and become friends with Mikoto recently, without the two of them knowing each other's background.
Translated from Getchu

Yozakura is a dark replica/clone of Sakura created by Umi during Umi's battle against everyone. In sharp contrast to Sakura, Yozakura rarely speaks and seemingly has no personalities since Umi does not care about giving her one.
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

Arizuka Jin is one of the participants in Odin's Ragnarök. Despite his young appearance, Jin is in fact the Game Master of Ragnarök, being able to call forth Eye Space and change the rules at will. Unlike most participants, he does not have something to protect but rather, wants to prove that he is more powerful than Odin.
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Jin is the self-proclaimed King of the Mahoutsukai, and his abilities has the power to prove it. Having been the Game Master and one of the participants of the last Mahoutsukai War, he has polished his abilities from the previous experiences he gained and is still in the process of further improving them. Although his ego led him to look down upon others once, his outlook on others have started to change little by little since his defeat in the war. Jin admires people who are strong, so that his strong ambitions would allow him to challenge and surpass them.
Among the "Mahoutsukai", Jin's abilities, in which others would call foul play, are very useful in battle. Jin is given the title "Chrono Kairos" in order to set him apart from the other Mahoutsukai.
Translated from Getchu
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description
One of Momiji’s friends, Hiyori is part of her noisy quartet of friends. She plays the role of a boke.
A simple girl who lives her life in praise while following her motto to "live a positive life".
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A beautiful girl who attracts boys to her parents' hot springs. Hiyori was Reiji's former classmate in the past. She is also a close friend and classmate of Sayuki, as well as an old acquaintance of Momiji. Hiyori is liked by everyone regardless of gender and age. Therefore, she has a wide variety of friends.

Hiyori believes that she will meet her fated partner in love one day, and is currently enjoying her life with her friends. Her motto is "to live a positive life". She may seem like a normal girl, but she can get slightly eccentric at times.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: アマテラス=姫 神琴
cast.originalCharacterName: アマテラス=姫 神琴

segments.text: The Sixth Seat of the "Seventh Chord". Mikoto was accepted into the "Seventh Chord" at the same time as Freya. An energetic young woman who likes to boast about her three sacred treasures of the current generation: "alcohol", "smartphones", and "getting what she wants when she pleads in tears". As the eldest of the three-man cell, she is usually the one to stop Freya's reckless charging to battles with Alicia's help. Mikoto has a very bright, bold, and carefree personality. She is also well-known as a troublemaker. Although she is a beautiful woman, Mikoto has a very frank personality that it makes it hard for her friends to dislike her.
In battle, Mikoto uses three "unique" sacred treasures that her mother created for her. Like the scorching fire of the Sun represented by her name, she specializes in manipulating fire magic.
Translated from Getchu

The Fifth Seat of the "Seventh Chord". A docile and taciturn girl who is always seen carrying her stuffed doll, Toy Box, close to her chest. Alicia is the daughter of Irmfrid. She acts as the senior member of Freya and Mikoto in their three-man cell. Because her ability is inferior compared to her two partners and her father is always there to help her, she has a secretive inferiority complex for not being able to be useful to the "Seventh Chord". However, her hidden abilities have not been unraveled because she is not matured enough.
Alicia is able to manipulate many dolls in battle, giving her the ability to create many fancy unique battle tactics.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: ユリウス=シャリオヴァルト
cast.originalCharacterName: ユリウス=シャリオヴァルト

segments.text: Freya's elder brother, and the Zeroth Seat of the "Seventh Chord". He is the total commander of the whole group. He was formerly a high ranking member of "Voluspa", a strictly confidential research organization. Julius is the ringleader of the secret force called the "Seventh Chord" that was created to defend the world from the "Mahoutsukai". Although Julius may seem like a cold-blooded person, he has a gentle side to him whenever he is with Freya, who was reunited with him after being separated for so long. The both of them share a deep familial love with each other.
Because Julius is the total commander, he does not participate in any of the battles.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: イルムフリート=ブルクハルト
cast.originalCharacterName: イルムフリート=ブルクハルト

segments.text: Irmfrid is a man with an overflowing dauntless personality. As the First Seat of the "Seventh Chord", he is the Knights's commander, as well as the strongest man of the group. Although he has fought through a great number of battles and won due to his overwhelming abilities, Irmfrid tends to prioritize helping his comrades in danger over winning the battle. At a glance, he may seem like a moody person who does not show any motivations for doing his duties. However, he considers anyone who is his friend as a part of his family. Irmfrid tends to dote on his daughter, Alicia, and is very overprotective for her.
Irmfrid excels in close proximity combat where he deals one powerful blow to an enemy's body, bringing them to certain death.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: ファウスト=ノルベルト
cast.originalCharacterName: ファウスト=ノルベルト

segments.text: The Second Seat of the "Seventh Chord". He acts as a right-hand man, and gathered up the members of the group in place of the Knights's leader. A buoyant old man who is a very influential person in the "Seventh Chord" that has witnessed many scenes of bloodshed. His general hobby is outdoor fishing. Faust tends to admire nature. On the other hand, he also has a broad knowledge on the latest technological developments in the city.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: ルドラ＝アンダルファイト
cast.originalCharacterName: ルドラ＝アンダルファイト

segments.text: A young boy who was raised as a bodyguard in the battlefield when he was younger, similar to Yuria. The Fourth Seat of the "Seventh Chord". In order to survive in the battlefield without any mentors, he grew up fighting. Due to his sense of pride for his combat abilities, he tends to fight alone without relying on his teammates in battle. However, he does show respect towards others's abilities. Hence, he has a good camaraderie towards the other members in the "Seventh Chord".

Rudra has the talent of a genius when it comes to magic combat. During his days in the military, his hand-to-hand combat skills were enough to put the other adult soldiers to shame despite being a child soldier at the time.
Translated from Getchu

cast.characterName: ユリア=クロノシュネーヴァイシェン
cast.originalCharacterName: ユリア=クロノシュネーヴァイシェン

segments.text: The Third Seat of the "Seventh Chord". Yuria is known as the "elder sister figure" from Mikoto, due to her honorable and cool personality. A very charismatic individual since her youth, her superiority is even acknowledged by Faust as a hero. She was taken in by the organization when she was seriously injured after falling down, and was brought up as a combat specialist. After the incident, she lost her childhood memories and her family origin, and has been actively looking for them on her own.

Proudful of her combat style as a sniper, Yuria is able to snipe at extremely long distances in a magic warfare. She always captures her targets and prevents them in escaping due to her excellent precision and advanced tactics.
Translated from Getchu
She is actually Kengo's older sister.

actors.name: 園崎未恵(そのざきみえ)

segments.text: fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description
The classmate with a (fake?) Kansai dialect accent who became friends with Reiji the day he transferred due to their similarity in nature. He is perverted and doesn’t mind telling people about it.
Taken from Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A fellow classmate who found a kindred spirit in Reiji and immediately became friends with him. Kengo seems to be the type of person who never left Tsukiyomi-jima Island, since he speaks in a (fake?) Kansai dialect accent. He is perverted and doesn’t mind telling people about it. Whenever Kengo opens his eyes, his keen stare coldly shines like a sharp knife. Having fought against Reiji before, their friendship deepened after they released their feelings through their fists.

Kengo's gentle personality may not be suitable for combat and his "abilities" have not reached their full potential, but his strategic sense in combat is good enough to make up for his fighting strength.
Translated from Getchu
Todoroki only knows only one rule in life, and that is - the bigger things are, the better. For him, strength is everything, strength comes from size, thus size equates to the only factor in a fight.
It’s hard to beat a logic as simple as that really.
Taken from Warum's Review
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description
Hinako's bodyguard, who doesn’t speak much. Not much is known about him. He’s the only one Hinako truly opens up to.
Edited from Warum's Review
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A taciturn man who is Hinako's bodyguard. Although he is Hinako's legal guardian, Hinako's existence is important to Keisuke like that of a precious daughter. In the past, Keisuke had lived a worthless life until Hinako's later father took him in and asked him to do a favor. That favor being to keep Hinako close to him like a momento and support her until she is able to live a calm and happy life.

Due to Keisuke's genuine loyalty, the loyalty which he believes in, he does not let out any of his true feelings and swore an absolute oath that he will put his life on the line for Hinako. Therefore, he does not expect any kind of hope to help him, and will continue to act as Hinako's sword to cut down all those who harm her like a cold-blooded battle machine.
Translated from Getchu
Loge was a Mahoutsukai who massacred many people during the Ten-Year War, Fimbulwinter. He was the one who instigated all the events in fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase.
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

During the last battle of Fimbulwinter, Loge's rampage occurred at the hospital where Yoshino Sousei's wife, Yoshino Sakura was being treated at. Despite Sousei's efforts to protect her, Sakura dies by Loge's flames. This in turn led Sousei to become Odin and 'killed' Loge out of anger and revenge. And thus, Odin sought to create another Mahoutsukai ritual called Ragnarök in order to revive his deceased wife.
Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description
It is revealed in the final Day of the story that Loge never died from Yoshino Sousei and was able to possess Julius (first playthrough only) and Freya. He is the true main antagonist of the game.
His voice actors depend on who he is possessing. When he possesses Julius, he has his voice, and when he possesses Freya, he has her voice.

Toy Box is a rabbit-like stuffed doll that Alicia carries with her everywhere. It is able to speak in human language on its own. Its straightforward attitude usually puts Alicia in an awkward spot in conversations.
Fermata is a living white knight armor who first appears as a third party in the war that interferes in the Mahoutsukai and Kisekitsukai battles and stops both sides from fighting each other.
Although Fermata is the set name in-game, Camellia may refer to it as the name you inputted at the beginning of the game in the text box.
Prior the final battle, Fermata's armor is used by Julius.
In the final battle, Fermata's armor was possessed by Camellia, the system voice that guides the player throughout the game, allowing it to unlock its final form.
The armor is voiced by Kakuma Ai when being possessed by Camellia.
The AI that controls the interface system, connecting "you (the player)" to the world of Kadenz.
She gives "you" many advice throughout the game.
Although she has many functions, most are not usable yet. When her "ability" is released, the truth of the world will appear.
Translated from PSV-Edition Website's Character Page

Reiji's father. Sousei was once an immortal Mahoutsukai who had eternal youth. However, he has lost his ability to become immortal and ageless, and has retired from the battlefield. With his wife, Sakura, Sousei is currently living and working in the orphange, "The Saint's Admonition", where Reiji grew up in.
Because he has a vast amount of battle experience than Reiji, Sousei is calmly watching over his son as a father.
Translated from Getchu
Umi's childhood friend who has a crush on her.
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

A war orphan who lost both his parents in the "Ten Year War" that occurred in Tsukiyomi Island sixteen years ago. He is your “average” teenager with an unfortunate past. A level-headed free thinker who deeply cares for those close to him and is easily agitated should they come in harm's way. One of his trademark traits is him fiddling with his hair whenever he is thinking.

He is the last Mahoutsukai who awakened his powers when his life was at risk. He is referred to as the "Missing Number 13". Because he was the last one to awaken his true potential, Reiji has no knowledge of magic at all. To make up for his lack of experience, his Magical Weapon of Tactical Destruction, Sakura, provides him the information he needs about his opponents. Even though he lacks battle experience, his brawls with his childhood friend, Ryuichi, allows him to adapt in his situation during battles. In addition, the amount of mana he has is extraordinary, to the point where he may surpass all the other mahoutsukais. Hence, he is deemed an "Irregular" in Ragnarok. With the ability to summon anything in the 24 hours timeframe, he is not suited for battle. However, he is excellent as a battle support that can heal or summon allies to the front lines.

Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

A young man who awakened his powers as a Mahoutsukai and won the last Mahoutsukai War, Ragnarok. Although he grew up as a war orphan, he is currently freeloading in the Sagara household. A level-headed free thinker who deeply cares for those close to him and is easily agitated should they come in harm's way. He is the factual leader of the "Mahoutsukai".

Reiji is able to create many strategies with flexible ideas from out of nowhere. Originally, he fought using his "Ability" that was not suited for battles; therefore, making him an unusual strategist-type "Mahoutsukai". However, his fighting capabilities are also very high. Reiji is able to forcefully pour enormous amounts of "Magic Power" into his fist, creating frightening destructive power when he fires it at his opponents.
